xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2836 — restore branch coverage ≥85% after v0.85.0 debt hatch

plan.title: test(coverage): restore branches >=85% after v0.85.0 hairline miss (84.95%)

narratives.Description: v0.85.0 shipped with --allow-coverage-debt=2836 after branches landed at 84.95% versus the 85% floor. Restore real branch coverage so the next release cut does not reuse the debt hatch.
narratives.Overview: Local task check / vitest coverage for the v0.85.0 cut reports branches 84.95% vs the global 85% floor. Follow-up MUST restore branches ≥85% without debt (same class as #2762 / #2630).
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Run vitest coverage and task coverage:hotspots to list lowest src/ modules and uncovered branch samples in the report. 2) Add focused unit tests under packages/core/src and packages/cli/src for those branch gaps (~17 hits) with fixture asserts. 3) Re-run the coverage report and confirm branches >=85% without --allow-coverage-debt=2836.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want branch coverage back at or above 85% without a debt hatch, so that release cuts enforce the real quality floor.

items.title: Given the current suite, when coverage is measured, then branches are at least 85%.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the current suite, when task check runs without --allow-coverage-debt, then reported branch coverage is at least 85%.

items.title: Given the debt hatch for 2836, when coverage is restored, then the hatch is no longer required.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the v0.85.0 debt allowance for #2836, when coverage is restored, then release/check paths no longer need --allow-coverage-debt=2836.

items.title: Given new branch-hitting tests, when the suite runs, then they stay green and raise coverage.

narrative.Acceptance: Given focused tests targeting the uncovered branches, when vitest runs those paths, then they pass and contribute the missing branch hits.

references.title: Issue #2836: test(coverage): restore branches >=85% after v0.85.0 hairline miss (84.95%)

expected_outputs: CHANGELOG Unreleased note if hatch retirement is user-visible
swarm.missing_traces_justification: Traced to GitHub issue #2836 acceptance and the v0.85.0 release debt comment rather than a SPECIFICATION section.
